feat: remove Gemini CLI, run research with Claude + Codex only

Gemini CLI was persistently flaky — frequent quota errors, sandbox
limitations requiring file-copying workarounds, and an internal retry
loop that hangs indefinitely on rate limits. The two-agent setup is
more reliable and still produces high-quality cross-pollinated research.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: read state file instead of relying on setup stdout

Claude Code keeps running the setup script in the background,
losing stdout. Instead of fighting that behavior, make the flow
resilient: after setup succeeds, read .claude/deep-research.local.md
to get research_id and config. This works regardless of whether
the bash command ran in foreground or background.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: prevent setup script from running in background

Claude Code was choosing to run the setup script with
run_in_background, then failing to read the task output
("No task found with ID"). Adding explicit instruction
to run in foreground so the output is readable.

Fix noglob exit status masking and add missing RESEARCH_PROGRESS_LOG for Claude

- Preserve setup script exit status when toggling noglob in deep-research command
- Add RESEARCH_PROGRESS_LOG env var to Claude agent launches in both phase runners
  so iteration progress appears in the progress log (was only set for Gemini)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
docs: use namespaced plugin slash commands in README
Refactor orchestration hooks and harden research workflow

Add pre-flight smoke tests, fatal error detection, e2e test runner, and testing guide

Smoke tests in setup-research.sh verify all 3 agent CLIs can make API
calls before launching expensive research sessions. Fatal error detection
in phase-common.sh polls agent stdout logs every 5s and kills agents
stuck in retry loops against quota/auth errors. The e2e test runner
(run-e2e-test.sh) drives the full 4-phase pipeline headlessly using
cheap models for CI/tmux testing.

Also adds unified iteration hook, shared phase library, unit test suite,
comprehensive testing.md guide, and fixes for bash 3.2 compat, zsh glob
expansion, and CLAUDECODE env var handling.

Add Research Council plugin: multi-agent deep research across Claude, Codex, and Gemini

3-phase pipeline:
- Phase 1: Three agents research independently in parallel with iterative loops
- Phase 2: Cross-pollination — each agent reads all reports and refines
- Phase 3: Main Claude synthesizes into a final report

Each CLI uses its native loop mechanism (Claude Stop hooks, Codex bash
wrapper, Gemini AfterAgent hooks). Supports --test mode with cheap models.
